notes:
Two shops adopted. The numbers rest on www.tokyourluxury.com — second-hand designer bags only, n=129, distinct ratio 97.7% — where values run from 47 g to 1,876 g with odd figures throughout, which reads as each item having been weighed. No second-hand shop carried real watch weights, so watches are stood in for by www.rookjapan.com's product_type Luxury Watch (n=834).

Three limits. (1) tokyourluxury's values are most likely the item alone, without padding or a box — an LV Mini Papillon at 89 g. Used as a shipping weight they need packing added, which is what measured: false means here. (2) The per-line n is thin, between 8 and 34; boston at n=8 and pouch at n=13 are especially uncertain. (3) The 839 g watch figure comes from a shop selling mostly new watches with the presentation box, which is a different object from a used watch shipped without one (a Rolex head alone is around 150 g). None of these three could be filled in from another shop.

Most second-hand luxury shops are useless here: luxuness is a flat 500 g, world.reclo and brandoffbuyingclub a flat 3,000 g, hannari a flat 1,000 g, and many Shopify shops simply leave grams at 0 (vintagelacharme, dct-ep, amorevintagejapan, myluxury-store, weeklyluxdrop, brandstreettokyo). On the other hand, the shipping bands at luxlux.jp and gracejapanluxuybrand order themselves as wallet < shoulder < handbag and tote < boston, which matches tokyourluxury's measured ordering — so the way the lines are cut is corroborated by two independent sources even though their numbers are not.

fallbackG 584 is the median of all 129 tokyourluxury rows.
notesJa: 採用は2店。数値の中核は www.tokyourluxury.com（中古ブランドバッグ専業、n=129、distinct比 97.7%）で、47〜1,876g の端数が並ぶことから一点ごとの実測に近い。時計だけは中古ブランド品店に実測値が無かったので www.rookjapan.com の product_type=Luxury Watch（n=834）で代用した。限界は3つ。(1) tokyourluxury の値は商品そのものの重量で、緩衝材・箱を含まない可能性が高い（LV ミニパピヨンが 89g）。発送重量として使うなら梱包分の上乗せが要る。measured:false はこの意味。(2) バッグ各ラインの n は 8〜34 と薄い。ボストン n=8、ポーチ n=13 は特に不確か。(3) 腕時計 839g は化粧箱込みの新品時計店の値で、箱なしで送られる中古実物（ロレックスの時計単体は 150g 前後）とは別物。この 3 点は他店では埋められなかった。中古ブランド品店の大半（luxuness 全件 500g、world.reclo/brandoffbuyingclub 全件 3,000g、hannari 全件 1,000g）は一律の擬似値で、Shopify でも grams を 0 のまま運用する店（vintagelacharme, dct-ep, amorevintagejapan, myluxury-store, weeklyluxdrop, brandstreettokyo）が多い。一方 luxlux.jp と gracejapanluxuybrand の送料区分は、財布 < ショルダー < ハンドバッグ・トート < ボストン という順序が tokyourluxury の実測順と一致しており、ライン分けの切り方自体は2系統で裏が取れている。fallbackG 584 は tokyourluxury 全 129件の中央値
